usage: 雞飯 is used as a noun to refer to a dish consisting of chicken served with rice.
You can use 雞飯 to talk about ordering food at a restaurant or cooking at home.
The word can be pluralized in English but stays the same in Cantonese regardless of quantity.
雞飯 can be combined with other words to describe specific styles, like 海南雞飯 (Hainanese chicken rice).
When using 雞飯 in conversation, it usually refers to the meal as a whole, not just the chicken or the rice separately.

examples.meaning: I want to eat chicken with rice.
